top_signals.title: Japan 2-Year Bond Sale Sees Firm Demand Before BOJ Decision
top_signals.summary: Japan’s two-year government bond auction drew firm demand, as elevated yields attracted investors ahead of a Bank of Japan policy decision on Friday, where rates are widely expected to remain unchanged.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: UK boosts support to Ukraine with £10 billion package
top_signals.summary: The UK will give a further £10 billion of economic and military support in the largest ever package of financial backing for Ukraine.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: U.S. Natural Gas Production Hits New Records as Demand Surges
top_signals.summary: U.S. natural gas production is on track to close a second consecutive year with record-high natural gas output as producers respond to demand signs both at home and overseas. Soaring demand for powering data centers in the United States and rising liquefied natural gas exports amid expanding liquefaction capacity, as well as surging global demand for spot LNG cargoes in the absence of Qatar’s gas due to the Iran war, are pushing American natural gas production higher this year. top_signals.title: South Africa Readies Backup Plan for Benchmark Rate Law Delay
top_signals.summary: The South African Reserve Bank and financial institutions are preparing a backup plan in case legislation needed for the switch to a new rand benchmark interest rate isn’t passed by the end of the year.
